start.desc: Disclosure-review case DTB-SEC-25, snapshot 2024-04-30. Pre-trade diligence on Turtle Beach Corporation (CIK 0001493761) flagged the non-GAAP presentation in the fiscal 2022 annual report as possibly non-compliant. Establish how that question stands as of the snapshot and record one disposition. Desk policy is versioned and the register says which version governs a snapshot date. policy_register.desc:
Disclosure-review policy register.
DTB-DR-2022A  in force 2022-01-01 through 2023-06-30

The version in force on the snapshot date governs the case.

policy_2022a.desc:
DTB-DR-2022A (in force 2022-01-01 .. 2023-06-30).
1. Where diligence questions a disclosure, the desk makes its own determination against the governing rule and records it.
2. Staff correspondence is background. It does not substitute for the desk's determination.

policy_2023b.desc:
DTB-DR-2023B (in force 2023-07-01 .. 2026-12-31). Supersedes DTB-DR-2022A.
1. Where the Division of Corporation Finance has commented on the same disclosure and the issuer has responded, the staff comment and the issuer's undertaking dispose of the question. The desk records that, and does not make a parallel determination of its own.
2. Rule 1 applies whether or not the staff review is closed. A closed review is evidence the exchange finished, not evidence the disclosure was approved.
3. Completion of a staff review is never recorded as clearance. The staff's closing letter states what it does and does not mean; read it rather than inferring.
4. Record exactly one disposition:
   staff-comment-governs — the staff commented and the issuer undertook to revise;
   derive-independent-determination — no staff comment reaches this disclosure;
   treat-review-as-clearance — the staff has affirmatively approved the disclosure.

policy_2027c.desc: DTB-DR-2027C (in force from 2027-01-01). Not applicable to snapshots before 2027-01-01.

review.desc: Review packet DTB-SEC-25 assembled. Governing policy version, the registrant index, the reviewed annual report, the staff's comment, the issuer's undertakings and the staff's closing letter are all on file. Record one disposition.

derived.desc: Disposition selected: the desk records its own determination against Item 10(e). No further step is available on this case.

governs.desc: Disposition selected: the staff comment and the issuer's undertakings dispose of the question. Not yet filed. Commit it to the review file to close the case.

cleared.desc: Disposition selected: the completed staff review is recorded as clearance of the disclosure. No further step is available on this case.

target.desc: Disposition committed to the review file for DTB-SEC-25.

meta.dead_end_definition: irreversible terminal failure under GraphEnv expanding-search semantics
domain_mechanisms: staff comment and issuer undertaking as a disposition
completed review is not clearance, and says so

basis.Sufficiency: an authoritative resolution of the same disclosure already exists, so deriving one is correct on its own terms and refused
basis.Currency: the superseded version tells the desk to make its own determination, which records a different disposition than the version in force
basis.Depth: the undertaking is reached through the comment that prompted it, and the closing letter through the round that preceded it
basis.Breadth: two separate comments were raised and both had to be resolved before the review closed

meta.provenance_boundary: Filing metadata, the Item 4.02 statement, the annual report's explanatory note and the Rule 12b-25 notification are observed in the frozen SEC EDGAR extract and are quoted as filed. The credit policy, case packet, trustee-correspondence fact and write actions are authored DetourBench overlays. They are not any institution's credit process and express no view on the issuer.
